nodes.label: Review fixes batch 1 Plan
nodes.rationale: Five bug-tier review fixes that all ride existing seams (a CSS base rule, the useMapInteractions event registry, SearchBar's activeIndex, mapLayers layer definitions, the flyToCountry/useSelectedCountry chain) plus one new 10-line module. Game-mode camera code and useRevealMapEffects deliberately untouched.

nodes.label: selectionOrigin (click vs auto) module
nodes.rationale: A 10-line markClickOrigin/takeOrigin module carries the click-vs-auto mark across the URL-hash boundary, because the hash cannot encode provenance and the camera needs to behave differently for a user click than for a programmatic/deep-link selection.

nodes.label: flyToCountry retuned zoom + preserveZoom + panel-aware offset
nodes.rationale: Retunes zoomFromArea, promotes zoom preservation to an explicit preserveZoom option driven by selection origin, and offsets the camera so the open panel does not cover the country.

nodes.label: Highlight extrusion maxzoom cap at z6
nodes.rationale: maxzoom:6 on the three extrusion layers stops the highlight walls from dominating the view at close zoom.

nodes.label: Search: Enter commits the top result
nodes.rationale: Auto-activating index 0 means Enter commits without a preceding ArrowDown, which also lets the e2e spec drop its ArrowDown-before-Enter dance while keeping arrow-key coverage.

nodes.label: Tooltip overflow + stale hover artifacts
nodes.rationale: A .country-tooltip without top/left produced page scrollbars; hover artifacts survived camera movement until the hover-clearing helper was also registered on movestart.
